CPU original src/atom_vec.cpp:951-959 has the else that writes v[j][0..2] unshifted. The KOKKOS buffer row has fixed stride 'elements = size_border + size_velocity', so the shortfall does not spill into the next atom, but every field packed after v inside the same row (angmom, molecule, q, mu, sp, radius, rmass, omega, DPD) is written 3 slots too early, while AtomVecKokkos_UnpackBorderVel unconditionally reads 3 velocity slots and then the remaining fields at the nominal offsets. The DEFORM_VREMAP=1 functor is instantiated only when pbc_flag!=0 && deform_vremap, i.e. exactly 'fix deform ... remap v' with comm_modify vel yes, so the path is reachable.

reasoning: Read all six forward-comm functors. AtomVecKokkos_PackComm (line 58) and AtomVecKokkos_UnpackComm (line 280) carry only _x, _mu, _sp and the four DPD scalars; their operator() bodies test MU_MASK, SP_MASK and DPDTHETA_MASK only — there is no RADIUS_MASK or RMASS_MASK case, and neither functor even holds a _radius/_rmass view. Same for PackCommSelf, PackCommSelfFused, PackCommVel and UnpackCommVel (PackCommVel/UnpackCommVel do handle OMEGA_MASK but not radius/rmass). src/atom_vec_sphere.cpp::process_args sets 'fields_comm = {"radius","rmass"}; fields_comm_vel = {"radius","rmass","omega"};' when radvary is 1, and set_atom_masks() therefore puts RADIUS_MASK|RMASS_MASK into datamask_comm/datamask_comm_vel while field2size makes size_forward reserve the slots. AtomVecKokkos::set_size_exchange() at the end of the same file has an eighth instance ('i < default_exchange.size()'). Purely a warning-hygiene issue: the vectors have a handful of entries, so no behavioural risk.

reasoning: AtomVecKokkos::~AtomVecKokkos() (src/KOKKOS/atom_vec_kokkos.cpp:48-53) is:  '{ // Kokkos already deallocated host memory\n  ngrow = 0; }'.  The pinned staging buffer is a raw allocation, not a Kokkos View: both perform_pinned_copy (src/KOKKOS/atom_vec_kokkos.h:257) and perform_pinned_copy_transform (:298) do 'buffer = Kokkos::kokkos_malloc<LMPPinnedHostType>(buffer_size);' / 'Kokkos::kokkos_realloc<LMPPinnedHostType>(buffer,buffer_size)' under #ifdef LMP_KOKKOS_GPU, and 'grep -rn kokkos_free src/KOKKOS/' returns nothing anywhere in the package. Untracked kokkos_malloc memory is not reclaimed by Kokkos::finalize(), so the buffer leaks. Adjusted severity: it is a single allocation per AtomVec instance (sized to the largest atom array span) leaked once per atom_style command, i.e. essentially once per run, and it is GPU-build only — a real leak and a leak-checker hit, but with no runtime consequence. Also note the destructor's comment is simply wrong for this member.
fix: In AtomVecKokkos::~AtomVecKokkos() add, guarded by '#ifdef LMP_KOKKOS_GPU', 'if (buffer) { Kokkos::kokkos_free<LMPPinnedHostType>(buffer); buffer = nullptr; buffer_size = 0; }', and drop/correct the misleading 'Kokkos already deallocated host memory' comment. Verify the AtomVec is destroyed before Kokkos::finalize() (LAMMPS deletes atom before tearing down KokkosLMP), otherwise the free must move into a pre-finalize hook.
